blocks.text:
After Carnival at night, two days at the falls and time in the Amazon rainforest, Búzios is a quiet end to the trip. The peninsula has many small bays, so you can spend the day as you like. Hire a buggy to explore several beaches or take a boat trip with stops for swimming.

There are no scheduled excursions on the free day. Pick a beach, walk along the shore, swim or spend the evening in town. You can also swap this part of the itinerary for an all-inclusive stay of at least three nights in Angra dos Reis.

blocks.text: 5 February · Arrival at Rio de Janeiro Airport, meeting and transfer to the hotel. Free time. Rio is green hills, blue skies, rocky peaks, bays, islands and beautiful beaches, Brazil’s second-largest city and one of the most beautiful in the world; at nightfall, the hillside lights encircle it like a shimmering necklace, and the promenades of Copacabana and Ipanema stay alive late into the night.
